basics.name: Ryan Chen
basics.tagline: Software engineer who learns fast, adapts quickly, and loves a challenging problem.
basics.summary: I'm a Computer Science student at Northeastern, graduating in December 2026. I started programming because of video games, and that curiosity led to co-ops building API frameworks and data pipelines at Verisk and name-matching and search features at Babel Street. Outside of code, I'm usually learning a new board game, trying out a recipe, or out with friends.

image.alt: Ryan at the Golden Gate Bridge

experience.title: Software Engineer Co-op
highlights: Shipped a Region-of-Origin classifier answering an enterprise customer's top accuracy complaint, validated on 600 multi-regional names, by building its SDK endpoint, CLI, ranked top-k predictions, and license gating

Fixed 4 customer-reported name-matching defects, including a cross-script false 100% match and a numeric leet-speak crash, by tracing normalization logic in the Java engine and adding regression tests

Produced multilingual person-name dictionaries of roughly 100K records in 13 languages by building Python pipelines that parse the Wikidata dump, merge OFAC-translated lists, filter by script, and deduplicate entries

Migrated 5 repositories to Java 25, including both search plugins, by updating builds, Docker images, and Jenkins CI/CD, surfacing Solr and OpenSearch Security Manager blockers that shaped the team's runtime roadmap

Corrected HTTP status codes on dynamic-config REST endpoints from 500 to 400/422 by remapping exception handling and adding integration tests, then back-ported to 5 Elasticsearch and OpenSearch release branches
Placed 2nd of 8+ teams at a company hackathon by building the OFAC sanctions-screening tool for an LLM-agent vendor-vetting workflow with entity relationship graphing and risk scoring

experience.title: Junior Software Developer Co-op
highlights: Standardized token management and authentication across 10+ internal services by designing a modular, reusable Secure Internal API framework and owning it from proof of concept through production deployment

Extended SFPublish, an internal S3-to-Snowflake API, from CSV-only to JSON ingestion by designing the SQL schema and delimiter configuration on the existing parser, so teams could publish JSON without conversion
Cut per-endpoint API deployment time by 30% by writing a Python deployment script that stores base endpoints and login credentials, and migrated legacy shell scripts to Python for maintainability

Automated customer data ingestion into Snowflake by building an event-driven Snowpipe pipeline from S3, defining the expected data schema, and validating that uploaded files auto-created and populated tables

experience.title: Senior Developer
highlights: Co-led a 3-dev team building a React/Tailwind client portfolio site for NUMAC, a student marketing consultancy
Built a React mobile app and landing page from high-fidelity designs for 3 Stones, a pre-launch real-estate startup
Redesigning the Shopify storefront for Purely Puff'd Up, a small-business client (in progress)

experience.title: Project Manager Assistant
highlights: Designed the landing page and contact form for a Zocdoc-style patient booking app based on competitor research

projects.name: CodeStack
highlights: Cut the steps to follow a user by 75% (4 to 1) by adding inline follow buttons on user lists, alongside a real-time follow/unfollow system over Socket.io and direct messaging with per-user privacy settings
Implemented two-factor authentication with QR-code enrollment and session timeouts with warning modals
Unified styling across 15+ components by replacing ad hoc styles with a centralized CSS variable theme system

projects.name: Fakebook Crawler
highlights: Created a web crawler in Python, capable of navigating through secure HTTPS connections using SSL, handling session management, and parsing HTML to efficiently extract secret flags from a simulated social media site

projects.name: Hexagonal Reversi
highlights: Developed a feature-rich Java implementation of Reversi on a hexagonal grid, utilizing Swing for a graphical user interface (GUI) and engineering a text-based view; applied advanced design patterns including MVC architecture, observer pattern, strategy pattern, and adapter pattern, ensuring modularity and maintainability of the codebase
